statements.t: “We expect a strong finish to 2026, with momentum accelerating in the fourth quarter as volume deliveries ramp across existing programs and we convert pipeline opportunities into customer programs.
Expecting significant progress to Adjusted EBITDA break even, including reiterating our forecast for break even at the operating platform level in Q4 2026.
Updating our outlook for full company Adjusted EBITDA break even from Q4 2027 to Q3 2027.
Through a combination of internal investment and targeted acquisitions in key areas, the Company is preparing to rapidly increase the production capabilities around new high demand platforms.
The Company expects similar gross margin levels in Q4 2026 due to mix with a recovery to historical levels with normal quarterly variability.

The growth in adjusted cash operating expenses reflected the inclusion of newly acquired businesses along with continued investment in Ondas' operating platform and infrastructure in support of our expected significant revenue acceleration in the fourth quarter of 2026 and beyond.
The Company expects continued strong momentum and is now targeting at least $550 million in full year revenue for 2026, which is an increase from the prior target of between $525 – $550 million.
For Q4 2026, the Company is targeting revenue of greater than $250 million.
The Company expects backlog to grow sequentially in the fourth quarter of 2026 based upon strong order visibility.

The Company expects Adjusted EBITDA losses to show significant declines in the coming quarters through higher operating leverage benefiting from strong growth in revenues and gross profits driven by visible demand tailwinds and increased operating leverage from Ondas expanding platform.
The Company continues to expect to see Adjusted EBITDA profitability in Q4 2026 at the operating platform level, which includes OAS and Ondas Sentinel.

The revised caption is intended to more clearly communicate the measure as a management-defined non-GAAP performance measure that excludes specified cash and noncash expenses and does not represent all operating expenses requiring cash settlement.
